content_of_post_to_comment: I've been putting off a lot of things lately, and now it's getting harder to get started. For those who've been through this, what helped you get back on track? Need help. TIA
comment: One thing that helped me was stopping trying to catch up on everything at once. The longer you put things off, the more overwhelming the whole pile starts to feel, so I'd pick one task that's almost ridiculously small and do just 5 minutes of it. Don't even worry about finishing. Getting started again is often harder than the actual work, and a little momentum can make the next step feel less intimidating.
